calling_contract.entry_stack: [esp+0] holds 32-bit return address pushed by caller; [esp+4] is first stack arg.
calling_contract.exit_stack: Each hle_crt_00XXXXXX MUST pop the 4-byte return address (ctx.ret_cdecl(mem)) plus `stack_cleanup` bytes (ctx.ret_stdcall(mem, stack_cleanup)), EXCEPT custom_stack (__EH_prolog3 / __chkstk).

functions.name: free
functions.notes: Frees guest heap block allocated by malloc/calloc/realloc/new; NULL is a no-op.

functions.name: operator_new
functions.notes: Allocates `size` bytes via guest_alloc (min 1 byte); returns VA in EAX.

functions.name: malloc
functions.notes: Allocates `size` bytes via guest_alloc (min 1 byte); returns VA in EAX or 0 on failure.

functions.name: operator_delete
functions.notes: Tail-jump thunk (jmp 0x004e00d0) to free(ptr).

functions.name: __security_check_cookie
functions.notes: Checks ECX against [0x54b458] GS cookie; no stack args (repz ret). Safe no-op if cookie untouched or matching.

functions.name: operator_delete_array
functions.notes: Tail-jump thunk (jmp 0x004e02f3) to free(ptr).

functions.name: operator_new_array
functions.notes: Forwards [esp+4] to operator new (0x004e0177); returns VA in EAX.

functions.name: operator_new_array_2
functions.notes: Forwards [esp+4] through 0x004de548 -> operator new (0x004e0177); returns VA in EAX.

functions.name: sprintf
functions.signature: int __cdecl sprintf(char* buf, const char* fmt, ...)
functions.notes: Formats printf specifiers reading guest varargs from [esp+12..]; writes NUL-terminated string to buf, returns length in EAX.

functions.name: strncmp
functions.signature: int __cdecl strncmp(const char* s1, const char* s2, size_t count)
functions.notes: Unsigned-char lexicographical compare up to `count` bytes; returns <0, 0, or >0 in EAX.

functions.name: std_exception_ctor_default
functions.notes: Initializes std::exception struct at ECX: [this+0]=0x0051bd40 (vftable), [this+4]=0, [this+8]=0; returns this in EAX.

functions.name: std_exception_ctor_what
functions.notes: Copies *pwhat into heap buffer at [this+4], sets [this+0]=0x0051bd40, [this+8]=1; pops 4-byte stack arg (ret 4); returns this in EAX.

functions.name: std_exception_ctor_copy
functions.notes: Copy-constructs std::exception at ECX from rhs; pops 4-byte stack arg (ret 4); returns this in EAX.

functions.name: std_exception_dtor
functions.notes: Sets [this+0]=0x0051bd40 and frees [this+4] if [this+8] != 0.

functions.name: memcpy_s
functions.signature: errno_t __cdecl memcpy_s(void* dest, size_t destsz, const void* src, size_t count)
functions.notes: Bounds-checked copy of `count` bytes from `src` to `dest`; returns 0 on success or EINVAL(22)/ERANGE(34).

functions.name: atexit
functions.notes: Registers guest cleanup callback VA (e.g., 0x00519fe0, 0x0051a020) for process exit; returns 0.

functions.name: _invalid_parameter_noinfo
functions.notes: MSVC8 CRT invalid-parameter handler (calls _invoke_watson if registered; safe log + return in HLE).

functions.name: memmove_s
functions.signature: errno_t __cdecl memmove_s(void* dest, size_t destsz, const void* src, size_t count)
functions.notes: Bounds-checked overlap-safe copy of `count` bytes from `src` to `dest`; returns 0 on success.

functions.name: sscanf
functions.signature: int __cdecl sscanf(const char* str, const char* fmt, ...)
functions.notes: Parses formatted tokens from guest string `str` into guest pointer destinations at [esp+12..]; returns matched field count in EAX.

functions.name: strncpy
functions.signature: char* __cdecl strncpy(char* dest, const char* src, size_t count)
functions.notes: Copies up to `count` bytes from `src` to `dest`, zero-padding remainder up to `count`; returns `dest` in EAX.

functions.name: strstr
functions.signature: const char* __cdecl strstr(const char* haystack, const char* needle)
functions.notes: Finds first occurrence of NUL-terminated `needle` in `haystack`; returns guest VA or 0.

functions.name: atoi
functions.notes: Jumps to 0x004e0ea6 -> strtol(str, NULL, 10); returns parsed 32-bit signed int in EAX.

functions.name: atof
functions.notes: Parses floating-point ASCII string and pushes double result onto x87 FPU stack (`ctx.fpu_push(val)`).

functions.name: _get_crtheap
functions.notes: Returns CRT heap handle [0x00553114] (must return non-zero handle in EAX; WinMain stores it in [0x0076e65c]).

functions.name: exit
functions.notes: Requests clean shutdown via hle_win32_post_quit(status) (do NOT abort host iOS app!).

functions.name: realloc
functions.notes: Resizes guest heap block via guest_realloc; returns new VA in EAX.

functions.name: strrchr
functions.signature: const char* __cdecl strrchr(const char* str, int c)
disasm_head: 0x004e166c: repne scasb al, byte ptr es:[edi]
functions.notes: Finds last occurrence of `(uint8_t)c` (including NUL) in `str`; returns guest VA or 0.

functions.name: wcstombs
functions.signature: size_t __cdecl wcstombs(char* mbstr, const wchar_t* wcstr, size_t count)
functions.notes: Converts UTF-16LE `wcstr` to Shift-JIS/CP932 or ASCII multibyte string in `mbstr` up to `count` bytes; returns byte count (excluding NUL).

functions.name: strchr
functions.signature: const char* __cdecl strchr(const char* str, int c)
functions.notes: Finds first occurrence of `(uint8_t)c` (including NUL) in `str`; returns guest VA or 0.

functions.name: isalnum
functions.notes: C-locale alphanumeric check (`std::isalnum((unsigned char)c)` or table mask 0x103); returns non-zero if alphanumeric, 0 otherwise.

functions.name: isdigit
functions.notes: C-locale decimal digit check ('0'..'9' -> non-zero 4, else 0).

functions.name: isprint
functions.notes: C-locale printable ASCII check (0x20..0x7E -> non-zero 0x80, else 0).

functions.name: __ehvec_dtor
functions.signature: void __stdcall __ehvec_dtor(void* ptr, size_t size, int count, void (__thiscall *dtor)(void*))
functions.notes: Calls `dtor` with ECX = ptr + i*size for i = count-1 down to 0 via call_indirect (pushing dummy return address before each dtor); ret 0x10.

functions.name: __ehvec_ctor
functions.signature: void __stdcall __ehvec_ctor(void* ptr, size_t size, int count, void (__thiscall *ctor)(void*), void (__thiscall *dtor)(void*))
functions.notes: Calls `ctor` with ECX = ptr + i*size for i = 0..count-1 via call_indirect (pushing dummy return address before each ctor); ret 0x14.

functions.name: _time64
functions.notes: Gets current Unix epoch seconds as 64-bit int, writes to `*timer` if non-null, returns low in EAX and high in EDX.

functions.name: memchr
functions.signature: const void* __cdecl memchr(const void* buf, int c, size_t count)
functions.notes: Scans `count` bytes at `buf` for `(uint8_t)c`; returns guest VA or 0.

functions.name: _difftime64
functions.notes: Computes `double(time1 - time0)` (if both >= 0) and pushes result onto x87 FPU stack (`ctx.fpu_push(diff)`).

functions.name: _endthreadex
functions.notes: Terminates current spawned guest worker thread cleanly (sets exit code).

functions.name: _beginthreadex
functions.signature: uintptr_t __cdecl _beginthreadex(void* security, unsigned stack_size, unsigned (__stdcall *start_address)(void*), void* arglist, unsigned initflag, unsigned* thrdaddr)
functions.notes: Spawns std::thread running guest `start_address(arglist)` with freshly allocated GuestMemory thread stack and CpuContext; returns synthetic thread HANDLE in EAX.

functions.name: _stricmp
functions.signature: int __cdecl _stricmp(const char* s1, const char* s2)
functions.notes: ASCII case-insensitive string compare; returns <0, 0, or >0 in EAX.

functions.name: _vsnprintf
functions.signature: int __cdecl _vsnprintf(char* buf, size_t count, const char* fmt, va_list ap)
functions.notes: Formats `fmt` using guest `va_list` pointer `ap` into `buf` (up to `count` chars); returns written count or -1 if truncated.

functions.name: strftime
functions.signature: size_t __cdecl strftime(char* str, size_t maxsize, const char* fmt, const struct tm* timeptr)
functions.notes: Formats 36-byte MSVC `struct tm` at `timeptr` (9 int32 fields: sec, min, hour, mday, mon, year, wday, yday, isdst) into `str`.

functions.name: remove
functions.notes: Deletes file mapped case-insensitively inside BYOC assets dir; returns 0 on success or -1.

functions.name: fclose
functions.notes: Closes guest FILE* stream if tracked in HLE FILE table (e.g. from fopen), else safe no-op returning 0.

functions.name: _localtime32
functions.notes: Converts 32-bit Unix timestamp `*timep` to local time and writes 9 int32 fields into static/TLS guest `struct tm` buffer; returns buffer VA in EAX.

functions.name: _snprintf
functions.signature: int __cdecl _snprintf(char* buf, size_t count, const char* fmt, ...)
functions.notes: Formats printf specifiers reading guest varargs from [esp+16..] into `buf` (max `count` bytes); returns chars written or -1.

functions.name: _strnicmp
functions.signature: int __cdecl _strnicmp(const char* s1, const char* s2, size_t count)
functions.notes: ASCII case-insensitive compare up to `count` chars; returns <0, 0, or >0 in EAX.

functions.name: vsprintf
functions.signature: int __cdecl vsprintf(char* buf, const char* fmt, va_list ap)
functions.notes: Formats `fmt` using guest `va_list` pointer `ap` into `buf`; returns written length in EAX.

functions.name: _controlfp_s
functions.signature: errno_t __cdecl _controlfp_s(unsigned int* currentControl, unsigned int newControl, unsigned int mask)
functions.notes: Updates masked x87 rounding/precision bits in `ctx.fpu_cw` and writes previous/current control word to `*currentControl` if non-null; returns 0.

functions.name: _clearfp
functions.notes: Clears sticky exception bits (0..5, 7) in `ctx.fpu_sw` and returns prior exception status in EAX.

functions.name: toupper
functions.notes: ASCII 'a'..'z' -> 'A'..'Z' conversion; returns result in EAX.

functions.name: _CxxThrowException
functions.notes: Logs C++ exception throw (type info VA + object VA) and either unwinds via C++ exception or handles cleanly without crashing; ret 8.

functions.name: __EH_prolog3
functions.notes: MSVC8 EH frame setup: caller pushes frame_size and sets EAX=handler; sets EBP=old_esp+4, saves old EBP at [EBP], [EBP-4]=-1, [EBP-8]=handler, [EBP-12]=old fs_0, fs_0=EBP-12, allocates frame_size + saved ebx/esi/edi + cookie, pops retaddr.

functions.name: memset
functions.signature: void* __cdecl memset(void* dest, int c, size_t count)
functions.notes: Fills `count` bytes at `dest` with `(uint8_t)c`; returns `dest` in EAX.

functions.name: memcpy
functions.signature: void* __cdecl memcpy(void* dest, const void* src, size_t count)
functions.notes: Copies `count` bytes from `src` to `dest` (uses memmove semantics to match VC8 overlap branch); returns `dest` in EAX.

functions.name: _alldiv
functions.notes: Signed 64-bit division a / b (truncating toward zero); result in EDX:EAX; pops 16 bytes (ret 0x10).

functions.name: _allrem
functions.notes: Signed 64-bit remainder a % b; result in EDX:EAX; pops 16 bytes (ret 0x10).

functions.name: _allmul
functions.notes: 64-bit integer multiplication a * b; low 64 bits in EDX:EAX; pops 16 bytes (ret 0x10).

functions.name: __alloca_probe
functions.notes: Stack probe helper: pops retaddr into EAX, subtracts original EAX (`size`) from ESP (ESP = old_esp_after_ret - size), preserves ECX.

functions.name: _alldvrm
functions.notes: Signed 64-bit divmod: quotient (a / b) in EDX:EAX, remainder (a % b) in EBX:ECX; pops 16 bytes (ret 0x10).

functions.name: DirectSoundCreate8_thunk
functions.signature: HRESULT __stdcall DirectSoundCreate8(LPCGUID pcGuidDevice, LPDIRECTSOUND8* ppDS8, LPUNKNOWN pUnkOuter)
functions.notes: Jumps through IAT 0x0051b008 (DSOUND.dll!ord_11); delegate directly to hle_iat_call(ctx, mem, 0x0051b008u).

functions.name: ov_clear

functions.name: ov_time_total

functions.name: ov_time_seek

functions.name: ov_info

functions.name: ov_read

functions.notes: Statically-linked libvorbisfile ov_read(...): decodes up to `length` PCM bytes into guest `buffer`; returns byte count (>0), 0 on EOF, <0 on error.

functions.name: ov_open_callbacks

functions.name: _ftol2_sse

functions.name: _ftol2
functions.notes: Truncates `st(0)` toward zero to 64-bit signed integer in EDX:EAX and pops `st(0)`.

functions.name: _CIatan

functions.notes: MSVC CRT x87 intrinsic: pops `exp = fpu_pop()`, reads `base = st(0)`, writes `std::pow(base, exp)` into new `st(0)` (net x87 stack pop 1).

functions.name: _CIsin
functions.notes: MSVC CRT x87 intrinsic: replaces `st(0)` in-place with `std::sin(st(0))` (net x87 stack change 0).

functions.name: _CIcos
functions.notes: MSVC CRT x87 intrinsic: replaces `st(0)` in-place with `std::cos(st(0))` (net x87 stack change 0).

functions.name: _CIacos
functions.notes: MSVC CRT x87 intrinsic: replaces `st(0)` in-place with `std::acos(st(0))` (net x87 stack change 0).
